Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the department of fish and wildlife from paying more than the appraised value for any real estate purchase.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the department of fish and wildlifefrom paying more than the appraised value for any real estate purchase;and amending RCW 77.12.037.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.12.037 and 2000 c 107 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The commission may acquire by gift, easement, purchase, lease,or condemnation lands, buildings, water rights, rightsofway, or othernecessary property, and construct and maintain necessary facilities forpurposes consistent with this title. However, under no circumstancesmay the commission or the department purchase any real estate orinterest in real estate for more than the appraised current use valueof the real estate or real estate interest. (2) The commission may authorize the director to acquire propertyunder this section, but the power of condemnation may only be exercisedby the director when an appropriation has been made by the legislaturefor the acquisition of a specific property, except to clear title andacquire access rightsofway. p. 1 HB 2934 (3) The commission may sell, lease, convey, or grant concessionsupon real or personal property under the control of the department.
